SELECT R.REL_ID AS relId, R.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, R.VER AS ver, R.TITLE AS title, R.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, R.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, TO_CHAR(R.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS planDt FROM OPS_RELEASE R LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON R.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'RELEASE_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = R.STATUS WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY R.REL_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_RELEASE R WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT R.REL_ID AS relId, R.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, R.CHG_ID AS chgId, R.VER AS ver, R.TITLE AS title, R.CONTENT AS content, R.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, TO_CHAR(R.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS planDt, TO_CHAR(R.DEPLOY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deployDt, R.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, R.RESULT AS result, R.DEPLOY_REF AS deployRef, R.DEPLOY_COMMIT AS deployCommit, R.DEPLOY_LOG AS deployLog, TO_CHAR(R.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_RELEASE R LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON R.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'RELEASE_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = R.STATUS WHERE R.REL_ID = #{relId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO OPS_RELEASE (SYS_ID, CHG_ID, VER, TITLE, CONTENT, STATUS, PLAN_DT, CHARGER_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{chgId}, #{ver}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status},
TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(#{planDt}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') NULL , #{chargerId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT I.RITEM_ID AS ritemId, I.REL_ID AS relId, I.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, I.ITEM_DESC AS itemDesc, I.ITEM_RESULT AS itemResult, IC.CODE_NM AS itemResultNm FROM OPS_RELEASE_ITEM I LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE IC ON IC.CODE_GRP = 'RELEASE_ITEM_RESULT' AND IC.CODE_ID = I.ITEM_RESULT WHERE I.REL_ID = #{relId} ORDER BY I.RITEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_RELEASE_ITEM (REL_ID, ITEM_NM, ITEM_DESC, ITEM_RESULT) VALUES (#{relId}, #{itemNm}, #{itemDesc}, #{itemResult})
